name: Best Western Plus Hotel Alpenrose
beschreibung: The Best Western Plus Hotel Alpenrose is a distinguished hotel in Kufstein, Tyrol. Enjoying a central location, it offers excellent access to the historic sights and attractions of the fortress city. The hotel features comfortably appointed rooms and suites. Guests are treated to an extensive daily breakfast buffet, while the on-site restaurant serves a refined selection of regional Tyrolean and international cuisine. Wellness facilities including a sauna and a fitness room provide leisure and rejuvenation. Fully equipped meeting rooms are also available for business gatherings and corporate events.
